column2: Claim this Herdr workspace as boss (or release it)
column3: Run `boss claim $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user (workspace, agent, status). On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Start the apply of an OpenSpec change in its own Herdr tab
column3: Run `boss dispatch $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user (change, runner, agent, tab/pane, status, policy). On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Preflight the permissions and prerequisites of a run (read-only; --fix for safe repairs)
column3: Run `boss doctor $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user (overall status and each check). On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Close the apply tab and clean up (requires archive/sync)
column3: Run `boss finish $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user. On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: List the durable wake items and acknowledge handled ones
column3: Run `boss inbox $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user. On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Append a dated entry to the project's autonomous-decision journal
column3: Run `boss journal $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user. On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Plan a large task as an ordered list of changes (start/status/next)
column3: Run `boss mission $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user (goal, each change with its derived state, progress; on `next` the started change or `mission_complete`/`executer_busy`/`change_not_ready`). On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Park a human-only change and release its workspace
column3: Run `boss park $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user. On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Assemble the read-only context for the post-apply mission reconciliation
column3: Run `boss reconcile $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user (charter state, remaining changes, backlog, open inbox items, journal tail). On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Resume a parked change with a fresh dispatch
column3: Run `boss resume $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user. On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Move a running apply's dispatcher to the verified caller or an explicit target
column3: Run `boss retarget $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user. On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Send the apply command to the existing apply agent again
column3: Run `boss retrigger $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user. On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Gather deterministic review facts for an apply: tasks, validate, tests, git, friction
column3: Run `boss review $ARGUMENTS --json` and summarize the JSON result for the user (tasks, validate, tests, git, friction). Read the changed files yourself to judge whether the diff is plausible. On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Start a boss tab in a project's workspace with the scoped runner config
column3: Run `boss session $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user (project, workspace, agent, tab/pane, status). On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Show where project and global agent skills live
column3: Run `boss skills dir $ARGUMENTS` and list the project and global skill directories for the user. On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Show the state of an apply: agent, tasks, diff, tab/pane
column3: Run `boss status $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user (agent state, open/done tasks, changed files, visible dialog if `blocked`). On error, report the error message from stderr.

column2: Make sure a waiter is armed for an apply so its next completion is reported
column3: Run `boss wait $ARGUMENTS` and summarize the JSON result for the user. On error, report the error message from stderr.
